title: Physically accurate OpenFOAM case generation for unseen geometries and turbulence-model changes (FoamBench Advanced, 13-case subset)

task_sources.name: CFDLLMBench FoamBench: 13-case subset of the 16-case Advanced split (OpenFOAM v10 revision provided by the authors) and evaluation scripts, BSD-3-Clause

metric.description: Physical success rate over the 13 included FoamBench Advanced cases: the fraction whose submitted case runs successfully within its wall-clock limit and has NMSE < 0.1 against the hidden reference, following CFDLLMBench's FoamBench Success Ratio. NMSE is computed with FoamBench's original implementation over available U, p, rho and T fields. Missing or failed cases count as 0; the denominator is always 13. Higher is better; the raw score is in [0, 1]. No model baseline has been measured for this subset.
